name: Lee Maracle
shortBio: Stó:lō First Nation philosopher, feminist theorist, and orator who theorized Indigenous storywork, internalized colonial patriarchy, and Salish relational ontology.
centralQuestion: How do Indigenous oral memory and storywork dismantle both settler-colonial erasure and internalized patriarchy?

keyWorks.title: I Am Woman: A Native Perspective on Sociology and Feminism
keyWorks.description: Pioneering Indigenous feminist philosophy diagnosing internalized oppression and reclaiming Salish womanhood.

keyWorks.title: Memory Serves: Oratories
keyWorks.description: Philosophical oratories on Stó:lō epistemology, ecological law, and collective healing.
